name: something-comforting
title: Something Comforting
summary: A Proof of Concept that plays a melody on the iPod speaker.
description: An example patch. The Settings menu has a Something Comforting item. When you select the item, the internal speaker of the iPod (the piezo) plays a part of "Something Comforting" by Porter Robinson. The patch can be used with all other patches and with Dark Mode.
details: Settings has a Something Comforting item after Clicker.
Select the item to play approximately 13 seconds of the melody.
The melody plays on the internal speaker, not in the headphones.
notes: The iPod does not react to the buttons while the melody plays.
The Clicker setting does not stop the melody.
This patch is an example of a patch that adds a Settings item.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch.
Listen to the internal speaker. The melody plays for approximately 13 seconds.
